summary: Full product-level QA of TrailMap application against the complete 1,783-trail dataset. All core architectural constraints (zero API keys, MapLibre + OpenStreetMap, strict coordinate preservation, independent content integrity) are fully verified and operational.

mediumIssues.title: Search function does not index trail landmarks array
mediumIssues.reproductionSteps:
1. Enter a search query for a specific landmark present in trail.sourceFacts.landmarks (e.g. 'סנט קלייר' or specific local points of interest).
2. View search results.
3. Observe that the trail is not returned unless that landmark term happened to appear verbatim in the title or summary.
mediumIssues.expectedBehavior: Trails should be discoverable by their extracted landmarks (sourceFacts.landmarks).
mediumIssues.actualBehavior: Search utility only matches title, subtitle, description, region, startPoint, endPoint, gpsName, and categories. Trails matching solely on landmark are omitted.
mediumIssues.recommendedFix: In search-utils.ts line 38, add: const matchLandmark = trail.sourceFacts?.landmarks?.some(lm => fuzzyHebrewMatch(lm, q)); and include matchLandmark in the return condition.

lowIssues.title: Search input text color has low contrast when unfocused
lowIssues.reproductionSteps:
1. Type text into the search bar in the Header.
2. Click anywhere outside the input to blur focus.
3. Observe the input styling.
lowIssues.expectedBehavior: Search query text should maintain high contrast and legibility against the header background at all times.
lowIssues.actualBehavior: Input has 'text-stone-900' (dark) on 'bg-nature-800/80' (dark green) when not focused, reducing readability until re-focused.
lowIssues.recommendedFix: Set unfocused text color to 'text-white' or keep input background permanently light (e.g. 'bg-white/95 text-stone-900').

lowIssues.title: Modal lacks keyboard Escape close handler and focus trapping
lowIssues.reproductionSteps:
1. Open any trail detail modal.
2. Press the Escape key on keyboard.
3. Press Tab repeatedly.
lowIssues.expectedBehavior: Pressing Escape closes the modal. Focus should be trapped inside the modal container and not leak to background page elements.
lowIssues.actualBehavior: Modal does not listen for Escape keydown event; focus cycles behind the backdrop.
lowIssues.recommendedFix: Add useEffect keydown listener for 'Escape' key calling onClose(), and add role='dialog' aria-modal='true'.

lowIssues.title: FilterBar lacks dedicated quick-toggles for Route Type and 4x4 Requirement
lowIssues.reproductionSteps:
1. Inspect FilterBar controls.
2. Note available controls: Viewport, Region, Difficulty, Water, Shade, Categories.
3. Attempt to filter exclusively for circular trails (מעגלי) or 4x4 trails.
lowIssues.expectedBehavior: Users should have intuitive filter toggles for route type and vehicle access in FilterBar.
lowIssues.actualBehavior: Route type and 4x4 requirements exist in data and modal, but are not exposed as filter selectors in FilterBar.
lowIssues.recommendedFix: Add a Route Type dropdown (מעגלי / הלוך-חזור) and a 4x4 toggle to FilterBar in the next UI iteration.

lowIssues.title: Production bundle chunk size exceeds 500 kB due to single vendor chunk
lowIssues.reproductionSteps:
1. Run npm run build.
2. Observe Vite warning: dist/assets/index-j5bQT0pk.js is 1,299 kB (355 kB gzip).
lowIssues.expectedBehavior: Large third-party libraries (maplibre-gl) should be split into dedicated vendor chunks.
lowIssues.actualBehavior: Application code and MapLibre GL JS are bundled into a single chunk.
lowIssues.recommendedFix: Configure build.rollupOptions.output.manualChunks to split 'maplibre-gl' into its own chunk.
